content.title: South Carolina blasts Southern in one of biggest blowouts in Women's March Madness history
content.text: Updated March 21, 2026, 5:02 p.m. ETCOLUMBIA — South Carolina women's basketball's 103-34 win over Southern in the first round of the Women's NCAA Tournament set a program record for largest margin of victory in a March Madness game.It also tied for the seventh-biggest win in women's March Madness history, according to the NCAA.The No. 1 seeded Gamecocks (32-3) held No. 16 seed Southern (20-14) to a season-low in points and field goal percentage (18%) on March 21. Sophomore forward Joyce Edwards scored 27 points, a tournament high for her.The Jaguars scored just two points in the third quarter and the 13-0 start for South Carolina was the best start this season.Now coach Dawn Staley's team waits to see if it will play either No. 8 Clemson or No. 9 Southern Cal. That game will be on March 23, also in Colonial Life Arena but a time is not yet finalized.South Carolina women's basketball vs Southern score End of 3Q: South Carolina 76, Southern 21Gamecocks hold Southern to just two points in the third quarter. Joyce Edwards sets personal March Madness milestoneWith 2:20 in the third quarter, Edwards is up to 25 points which is a personal career-high in a March Madness game, surpassing the 22 points she had against Tennessee Tech in last year's opener. HALFTIME: South Carolina 44, Southern 19The Gamecocks hold Southern to just 23% from the floor in the first half and shot 50% themselves, led by now 19 points from Edwards.Latson has eight points and three assists. Dawn Staley's gifts for Southern Women's basketballBefore the game, Dawn Staley gave all of Southern's players a sample of the Louis Vuitton perfume she wears. Southern doesn't score 10th point until 5:33 in 2QSouth Carolina's defense holding Southern to 23% from the floor to start the game. Joyce Edwards reaches double digit scoring with 6 minutes till halftimeEdwards has been working the give and go game inside the paint well, and has 13 points as she checks out and heads to the bench.South Carolina leads 29-10 End of 1Q: South Carolina 19, Southern 6Joyce Edwards has a team-high six points for the Gamecocks, who shot 47% from the floor in the first 10 minutes. Tessa Johnson exits game, returns by end of 1QTessa Johnson left the court and went back with a trainer with just under four minutes left in the first quarter but returned to the bench and is starting the second quarter. South Carolina starts on 13-0 run vs Southern: 5:01 in 1QThe Gamecocks with their largest to start the season per the ESPN broadcast.What time does South Carolina vs Southern start? Where: Colonial Life Arena in Columbia, South CarolinaDate: March 19Time: 1 p.m. ETWhere to watch South Carolina first March Madness gameTV: ABC which is available on Fubo, which offers a free trialSteaming: ESPN+How to watch online: Watch ESPN (here's how to stream it live)South Carolina vs Southern injury reportSouth CarolinaChloe Kitts: OutAdhel Tac: OutMaddy McDaniel: OutHow many No. 1 seeds have beaten No. 16 seeds in March Madness?On the men's side, No. 1 seeds are 162-2 all-time against No. 16 seeds.On the women's side, it's only happened once, in 1998 when No. 16 Harvard beat No. 16 Stanford.Where Dawn Staley ranks among coaches with most NCAA women's basketball championshipsGeno Auriemma, UConn (12)Pat Summitt, Tennessee (8)Kim Mulkey, Baylor and LSU (4)Dawn Staley, South Carolina (3)Tara VanDerveer, Stanford (3)Linda Sharp, Southern Cal (2)Muffet McGraw, Notre Dame (2)Where is Southern University?Southern University is an HBCU in Baton Rouge, Louisiana.Dawn Staley's March Madness record at South CarolinaStaley is 49-16 in the NCAA Tournament heading into this year.Dawn Staley contract, salaryOn Jan. 17, 2025, Staley's became the highest-paid college women’s basketball coach in the history of the sport.Staley's new contract took effect immediately and runs through 2029-30. She's receiving annual salary of $4 million with a $250,000 increase every season and a $500,000 signing bonus that makes the total value approximately $25.25 million.South Carolina women's basketball startersWith all players healthy, coach Dawn Staley's starting lineup is:PG- Raven JohnsonG- Ta'Niya LatsonG- Tessa JohnsonF- Joyce EdwardsC- Madina OkotSouth Carolina women's basketball 2025-26 rosterSenior Raven Johnson - Guard, No. 25Senior Ta'Niya Latson - Guard, No. 00Senior Chloe Kitts - Forward, No. 21Senior Maryam Dauda - Forward, No. 30Senior Madina Okot - Center, No. 11Junior Tessa Johnson - Guard, No. 5Sophomore Maddy McDaniel - Guard, No. 1Sophomore Joyce Edwards - Forward, No. 8Sophomore Adhel Tac - Forward, No. 15Freshman Ayla McDowell - Guard, No. 24Freshman Agot Makeer - Guard, No. 44Chloe Kitts injurySouth Carolina starting forward Chloe Kitts tore her ACL and will miss the entire 2025-26 season. Her father Jason confirmed via social media on Oct. 14 that she had a successful surgery and began the road to recovery.Kitts still travels with the team.She is returning next year, Staley confirmed on Feb. 25.Is Ashlyn Watkins playing for South Carolina this season?Ashlyn Watkins tore her ACL in Jan. 2025 and was set to return this season but won't.
